name: Kenkyuu Nisshi
source:
University laboratory. Main character is a 25-year-old doctor who conducts sex psychology and does laboratory research on dreams and psychology of sex in the laboratory. 
He sets up an experiment sending various images to the dreams of two girls and observing result during daytime.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在一間大學研究室。主角是一名25歲的心理學博士，在大學教授心理學，同時研究性心理，以及夢境與心理之間的關係。
他設計了一項實驗：向兩名少女的夢中傳送各類影像，再於白天觀察這些影像產生的影響。

［引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]］
